metadata.title: System Security and Privacy Plan – Secure High-Performance Computing Platform

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: System architecture and governance are aligned to NIST SP 800-234 (High-Performance Computing Security Guide).

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Referenced for cyber resiliency guidance addressing long-running workload survivability, coordinated recovery, and mission continuity in tightly coupled compute environments.

system-characteristics.description: A shared, scheduler-mediated high-performance computing platform supporting institutional and research workloads with explicit trust boundaries, job-centric security controls, governed performance trade-offs, and behavioral monitoring.

authorization-boundary.description: Includes all shared compute nodes, batch schedulers, login nodes, shared storage systems, accelerators, HPC fabrics, identity systems, and monitoring components used to deliver HPC services.

users.title: HPC Platform Administrator
users.description: Responsible for operation and maintenance of HPC compute nodes, schedulers, operating systems, fabrics, and accelerators.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Systems Administrator per NIST NICE Framework (SP 800-181).

users.title: HPC Scheduler Operator
users.description: Manages scheduler configuration, queues, execution policies, and resource fairness controls.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Scheduler operation aligns with Systems Administrator responsibilities.

users.title: HPC Security Operations
users.description: Responsible for behavioral monitoring, anomaly detection, incident response, and insider misuse investigation within the HPC environment.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Security Operations Analyst per NIST NICE Framework.

users.title: HPC User
users.description: Authorized researcher or institutional user submitting non-interactive batch jobs to the HPC platform.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Research and Development Specialist per NIST NICE Framework.

users.title: Federated Identity Administrator
users.description: Manages federated identity relationships and external access to the HPC environment (if applicable).

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Identity and Access Management Specialist per NIST NICE Framework.

components.title: Secure High-Performance Computing
components.description: Composite trust assertion for secure operation of shared high-performance computing environments.

implemented-components.remarks: Applicable only when external or cross-institution federation is enabled.

control-implementation.description: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 controls are satisfied through assertions in adopted HPC trust patterns. Detailed control implementations are defined in component-definitions and inherited by this SSP.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Access control is satisfied via hpc-identity-and-access and scheduler-mediated job execution.
Audit and accountability are satisfied via scheduler logs and hpc-behavioral-monitoring.
System and communication protection is satisfied via hpc-core and hpc-fabric-and-accelerator-trust.
System integrity is satisfied via job lifecycle enforcement and behavioral anomaly detection.
Availability and resilience are satisfied via scheduler fairness and resource governance.
